title: Countries with the most coral reef
measure: Area of shallow, warm-water coral reef in each country's waters, in km², including overseas territories. From the UN's World Atlas of Coral Reefs, the first detailed global map of reefs. Measured around 2000; many reefs have since been damaged by warming seas.

entries.name: Indonesia
entries.note: About 18% of the world's reefs, at the heart of the Coral Triangle.
entries.source: Spalding, Ravilious and Green, World Atlas of Coral Reefs (UNEP World Conservation Monitoring Centre, 2001)

entries.name: Australia
entries.location: Great Barrier Reef, Ningaloo and others
entries.note: Home to the Great Barrier Reef, the largest reef system on Earth.
entries.source: Spalding, Ravilious and Green, World Atlas of Coral Reefs (UNEP World Conservation Monitoring Centre, 2001)
